blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: ScreenCalib enables light detection and ranging (LiDAR)--camera extrinsic calibration using an ordinary programmable display, providing known visual markers and controlled geometry while reducing dedicated target preparation. The camera observes displayed AprilTags, whereas the LiDAR measures the physical screen surface and boundary, requiring indirect cross-modal association. Display geometry introduces association ambiguities, while indoor clutter complicates extraction. ScreenCalib addresses these challenges through tag-guided display extraction, geometric hypothesis generation and refinement, and surrounding scene edges for ambiguity resolution. The single-pose mode requires only one static placement. The joint multi-pose mode combines independent static observations through cross-pose consensus and jointly refines the shared extrinsics and tag scale, reducing sensitivity to tag-size measurement errors without requiring continuous motion or inter-pose trajectory estimation. Experiments in simulation and on three different sensor platforms cover mechanical and nonrepetitive LiDARs in clean and cluttered environments. Benchmark results show that ScreenCalib outperforms competitive calibration-board-based methods in translation accuracy. Joint multi-pose refinement further reduces mean rotation and translation errors across the three platforms and improves rendered-map alignment. Evaluation across readily available displays, including cell phones, tablets, laptops, computer monitors, and televisions, further examines ScreenCalib's versatility as a practical alternative to dedicated calibration targets. The source code is available at https://github.com/ZuhaoZou2026/ScreenCalib.
blocks.zh: ScreenCalib可以使用普通可编程显示器进行光探测和测距(LiDAR)-摄像头校准,提供已知的视觉标记和控制几何,同时减少专用目标准备. 摄像头显示的是April Tags,而LiDAR测量物理屏幕表面和边界,需要间接的跨模式结合。 显示几何会引入关联模糊性,而室内杂交则会使提取复杂化. ScreenCalib通过标记制导的显示提取,几何假说生成和完善,以及周围的场景边缘以模糊分辨率来应对这些挑战. 单pose模式只需要一个静态放置. 联合多pose模式通过交叉pose共识将独立的静态观测结合起来,并联合完善共享的外延和标记尺度,降低对标记大小测量误差的敏感度,而不需要连续运动或交叉pose轨迹估计. 模拟实验和在三个不同的传感器平台上进行的实验覆盖了清洁和杂乱环境中的机械和非重复的LiDARs. 基准结果表明,ScreenCalib在翻译准确性方面优于竞争性校准板方法。 联合多功能改进进一步减少三个平台的均值旋转和翻译错误,改善渲染图的对齐. 包括手机、平板电脑、笔记本电脑、计算机显示器和电视在内的现成显示器的评价,进一步审查了ScreenCalib的多功能性,将其作为专用校准目标的一种实用的替代办法。 源代码见https://github.com/ZuhaoZou2026/ScreenCalib.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Accurate extrinsic calibration between light detection and ranging (LiDAR) sensors and cameras is fundamental to multimodal perception [ 1 ] , multimodal place recognition [ 2 ] , and three-dimensional reconstruction [ 3 ] . In practical robotic systems, however, calibration is constrained not only by estimation accuracy, but also by how easily reliable calibration observations can be obtained during deployment. Existing methods typically make a trade-off between these two requirements. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , target-based methods deliberately introduce known and repeatable geometric structures, but require dedicated target preparation and deployment. Targetless methods substantially reduce this burden, but the available calibration constraints depend on the surrounding environment and sensor motion. When the scene does not provide sufficiently informative geometry or texture, or when the motion excitation is inadequate, the calibration problem can become weakly constrained, leading to unstable estimates, degraded accuracy, or even calibration failure. This raises a straightforward practical question: can we achieve reliable and repeatable LiDAR–camera calibration without carrying and setting up a dedicated calibration target?
blocks.zh: 光探测和测距(LiDAR)传感器和相机之间的准确外部校正对于多式联运感知[1]、多式联运位置识别[2]和三维重建[3]至关重要。 然而,在实际的机器人系统中,校正不仅受到估计准确性的限制,而且在部署期间如何容易获得可靠的校正观测也受到限制. 现行方法通常在这两项要求之间作出取舍。 如图1所示,基于目标的方法有意引入已知和可重复的几何结构,但需要专门的目标准备和部署。 无目标方法能大大地减轻这种负担,但现有的校正限制取决于周围的环境和传感器运动. 当场景没有提供足够的信息几何或纹理时,或者运动激起力不足时,校正问题可能会变得弱受制约,导致估算不稳定,精度退化,甚至校正失败. 这提出了一个直接的实际问题:我们能否实现可靠和可重复的LiDAR-camera校准,而不携带和设定一个专门的校准目标?

blocks.en: Target-based LiDAR–camera calibration uses specially designed structures, such as planar boards, circular holes, or checkerboards, to establish explicit cross-modal correspondences [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] . The known and repeatable target geometry (as priors) generally provides well-constrained and reliable calibration. However, this comes with a relatively high deployment burden, as the target must be fabricated or printed, accurately measured, transported, and positioned for each calibration.
blocks.zh: 基于目标的LiDAR-camera校正使用专门设计的结构,如平板、圆孔或跳板,以建立明确的跨模式通信[4、5、6]。 已知和可重复的目标几何学(如前所为)一般提供训练有素和可靠的校正. 然而,部署负担相对较重,因为目标必须被伪造或印刷、精确测量、运输和为每次校准定位。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Comparison of target-based, ScreenCalib, and targetless LiDAR–camera calibration. Target-based methods provide known and repeatable geometry and direct cross-modal association, but require dedicated target preparation. Targetless methods minimize deployment burden by exploiting natural scene structure, but the available calibration geometry depends on the environment. ScreenCalib uses an ordinary programmable display to retain known calibration geometry while reducing dedicated target preparation. Its main challenges are the indirect association between camera and LiDAR observations and the cluttered environments in which displays are commonly located.
blocks.zh: 发相. 1:基于目标的ScreenCalib和无目标的LiDAR-camera校正的比较. 基于目标的方法提供已知和可重复的几何和直接的跨模式结合,但需要专门的目标准备。 无目标方法通过利用自然场景结构来将部署负担最小化,但可用的校正几何取决于环境. 屏幕 卡利布使用普通可编程显示来保留已知的校正几何并同时减少专用目标准备. 其主要挑战在于相机和LiDAR观测之间的间接关联以及显示器通常所在的杂乱环境.

blocks.en: Targetless methods occupy the other end of this trade-off. They avoid dedicated calibration objects by exploiting natural scene appearance, geometric structures, sensor motion, or learned cross-modal correspondences [ 7 , 8 ] . This reduces deployment burden, but the resulting calibration strongly depends on scene structure and motion excitation; insufficient or repetitive observations can lead to unstable estimates or calibration failure. Some methods also rely on accurate initialization, odometry, or trajectory optimization, further increasing sensitivity to acquisition conditions.
blocks.zh: 无目标方法占据了这一取舍的另一端。 它们通过利用自然场景外观,几何结构,感应运动,或所学到的交叉式通信来避免专用校正对象[7,8]. 这减轻了部署负担,但由此产生的校正很大程度上依赖于场景结构和运动激起;不充分或重复的观测会导致不稳定的估计或校正失败. 一些方法还依赖于准确的初始化,odometry,或轨迹优化,进一步提高了对获取条件的敏感性.

blocks.en: ScreenCalib is designed to reduce this dependency without returning to a specially manufactured calibration target. Instead of carrying and setting up a dedicated board, we use an ordinary display as a programmable cross-modal calibration interface . The displayed pattern provides known and repeatable visual geometry to the camera, while the physical display surface and its finite boundary provide geometric structure to the LiDAR. The displayed content can be electronically generated and adjusted according to sensing distance, field of view, and image resolution, without printing, attaching, or machining a dedicated target. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , this places ScreenCalib between conventional target-based and targetless calibration: it preserves a user-provided and repeatable calibration structure while substantially reducing the deployment burden associated with a dedicated target.
blocks.zh: ScreenCalib旨在减少这种依赖性,而不恢复到专门制造的校准目标. 我们不携带和设置专用板,而是使用普通显示器作为可编程的跨模式校正接口。 所显示的图案为相机提供了已知和可重复的视觉几何,而物理显示表面及其有限边界为LiDAR提供了几何结构. 所显示的内容可以根据感知距离、视野和图像分辨率进行电子生成和调整,而无需打印、附加或操纵专用目标。 如图1所示,这把ScreenCalib置于基于常规目标与无目标校正之间:它保留了用户提供且可重复的校正结构,同时大幅减少了与专用目标相关的部署负担。

blocks.en:
Importantly, however, a display is not simply an electronic replacement for a conventional calibration board. In conventional target-based calibration, both sensing modalities are typically associated through the same physical target features. In ScreenCalib, the two modalities observe different manifestations of the display. The camera directly observes the displayed AprilTags, whereas the LiDAR generally cannot observe these visual fiducials and instead measures the physical screen surface and boundary. The cross-modal relationship must therefore be established indirectly through their shared display geometry.
This is the first practical difficulty.
blocks.zh:
然而,重要的是,展示不仅仅是对常规校准板的电子替换。 在传统的以目标为基础的校正中,这两种感知方式通常通过相同的物理目标特征联系在一起。 在ScreenCalib中,两种模式观测显示的不同表现. 相机直接观测所显示的AprilTags,而LiDAR一般无法观测到这些可视可视光纤,而是测量物理屏幕表面和边界. 因此,必须通过共享显示几何来间接地建立跨模式关系。
这是第一个实际困难。

blocks.en: The second one is that, the planar geometry of the display inherently introduces association ambiguities: multiple permutations of the four image and LiDAR corners may produce apparently plausible initial transformations. These characteristics make display-based calibration substantially different from directly applying a conventional calibration-board pipeline.
blocks.zh: 第二是,展示的平面几何本身就引入了关联模糊:四个图像和LiDAR角的多层外观可能会产生明显可信的初始转变. 这些特性使以显示为基础的校正与直接应用常规校正板管有很大不同。

blocks.en: The third practical difficulty arises from where displays are normally used. Unlike a dedicated calibration target that can be placed in a clean acquisition area, displays are commonly located in offices, laboratories, and other cluttered indoor environments. Nearby objects can generate competing image edges and planar LiDAR clusters, while the display boundary may be sparsely or noisily sampled, especially by nonrepetitive solid-state LiDARs.
blocks.zh: 第三个实际困难来自通常使用展示的地方。 与可被放入清洁取地的专用校正目标不同,展示通常位于办公室,实验室等杂乱的室内环境中. 相近的物体可以产生相竞的图像边缘和平面LiDAR集群,而显示的边界可能很少或无序地被采样,尤其是被非重复的固态LiDARs所采样.

blocks.en: Furthermore, ScreenCalib requires a measured AprilTag side length as input, and this measurement may be inaccurate. In single-pose data, LiDAR measurement noise can inflate points near the display boundary, making it difficult to jointly estimate the tag size and extrinsics accurately. This motivates joint multi-pose calibration.
blocks.zh: 此外,ScreenCalib要求以AprilTag为输入量,这种测量可能不准确。 在单位数据中,LiDAR的测量噪声会使显示边界附近的点膨胀,因此难以共同估计标记大小和外延. 这推动了联合多项目校正。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we propose ScreenCalib , a display-based LiDAR–camera calibration framework with single-pose (SP) and multi-pose (MP) modes. The main contributions are as follows: • Robust Display Extraction in Two Different Modalities. We use an ordinary programmable display as a calibration target. On the camera side, AprilTag detections define a reliable polygon around the displayed pattern. Because the pattern and outer display boundaries are parallel in the display plane, the projected pattern edges guide the search for the outer display boundary in the image.
The AprilTag-derived depth prior range-filters LiDAR points
for display-cloud extraction. The detected tags also provide a pixel-to-meter ratio, which, together with the image-polygon size, gives a metric size cue for LiDAR display extraction.
Experiments in cluttered environments demonstrate the robustness of display extraction. • Single-pose calibration with indirect cross-modal association. We develop a complete calibration pipeline requiring only one static display placement. Multiple camera–LiDAR display associations are explicitly retained, initialized from the display geometry, refined by finite-support registration, and validated using surrounding cross-modal scene structures. This enables rapid calibration even when the display is surrounded by cluttered indoor objects. • Joint multi-pose calibration. We extend the framework to multiple independently captured static display observations without requiring continuous motion or inter-pose trajectory estimation. Cross-pose consensus selection identifies a consistent initialization from single-pose extrinsic proposals. Joint optimization then combines image-edge, plane, and normal constraints to refine a shared LiDAR–camera transformation and a correction to the user-measured AprilTag size. Fig. 2: Examples of display devices used in the ScreenCalib evaluation, each showing the calibration pattern: (a) cell phone, (b) tablet, (c) laptop, (d) computer monitor, and (e) television. • Carefully designed experimental evaluation. We examine complementary aspects of the framework: simulation with ground truth; three real LiDAR–camera systems, including mechanical and nonrepetitive LiDARs; clean and cluttered environments; indirect real-world accuracy assessment against Kalibr-estimated inter-camera extrinsics; qualitative assessment through rendered point-cloud alignment; sensitivity to user-measured AprilTag size; and calibration across five display types (Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用ScreenCalib(ScreenCalib)这一基于显示的LiDAR-camera校正框架,采用单人模式和多人模式。 主要贡献如下: • 按两种不同方式进行强力显示提取。 我们使用普通可编程显示作为校正目标. 在相机方面,AprilTag探测器定义了围绕所显示模式的可靠的多边形. 由于图案和外表显示边界在显示平面中是平行的,所预测的图案边缘会引导在图像中搜索外表显示边界.
AprilTag 从深度导出的前测距过滤器 LiDAR 点
用于显示- 云提取。 被检测到的标记还提供了像素相比,与图像-多乐贡大小一起给出了LiDAR显示取出的一个度量大小提示.
在杂乱的环境中进行的实验表明,展示提取是坚固的。 • 与间接跨模式协会进行单人组合校正。 我们开发一个完全的校正管道,只需要一个静态显示装置。 多相机 - LiDAR 显示关联被明确保留,从显示几何开始初始化,由有限支持注册来完善,并使用周围的跨模式场景结构进行验证. 这使得即使在显示器被杂乱的室内物体所包围时也能快速校准. · 多头联合校正。 我们把框架扩大到多个独立捕获的静态显示观测数据,而不需要连续运动或相位轨迹估计。 跨项目协商一致选择从单项目外部提案中确定了一致的初始化。 联合优化之后结合了图像对接,平面,以及正常的制约来完善共享的LiDAR-camera转换并修正用户测量的AprilTag大小. 发相. 2:ScreenCalib评价中使用的显示设备实例,每个显示校正模式:(a)手机,(b)平板电脑,(c)笔记本电脑,(d)计算机显示器,(e)电视。 二. 支助 精心设计实验评价. 我们审查了框架的互补方面:地面真伪模拟;三个真正的LiDAR-相机系统,包括机械和非重复的LiDARs;清洁和杂乱的环境;针对Kalibr估计的相机相机外观的间接现实世界准确性评估;通过使点-云对齐进行质量评估;对用户测量的AprilTag大小的敏感性;以及五种显示类型的校正(图2)。

Robust Display Extraction in Two Different Modalities. We use an ordinary programmable display as a calibration target. On the camera side, AprilTag detections define a reliable polygon around the displayed pattern. Because the pattern and outer display boundaries are parallel in the display plane, the projected pattern edges guide the search for the outer display boundary in the image.
The AprilTag-derived depth prior range-filters LiDAR points
for display-cloud extraction. The detected tags also provide a pixel-to-meter ratio, which, together with the image-polygon size, gives a metric size cue for LiDAR display extraction.
Experiments in cluttered environments demonstrate the robustness of display extraction.

以两种不同方式显示强力提取。 我们使用普通可编程显示作为校正目标. 在相机方面,AprilTag探测器定义了围绕所显示模式的可靠的多边形. 由于图案和外表显示边界在显示平面中是平行的,所预测的图案边缘指导了图像中外表显示边界的搜索.

blocks.en: Single-pose calibration with indirect cross-modal association. We develop a complete calibration pipeline requiring only one static display placement. Multiple camera–LiDAR display associations are explicitly retained, initialized from the display geometry, refined by finite-support registration, and validated using surrounding cross-modal scene structures. This enables rapid calibration even when the display is surrounded by cluttered indoor objects.
blocks.zh: 与间接跨模式协会进行单人组合校正。 我们开发一个完全的校正管道,只需要一个静态显示装置。 多相机 - LiDAR 显示关联被明确保留,从显示几何开始初始化,由有限支持注册来完善,并使用周围的跨模式场景结构进行验证. 这使得即使在显示器被杂乱的室内物体所包围时也能快速校准.

blocks.en: Joint multi-pose calibration. We extend the framework to multiple independently captured static display observations without requiring continuous motion or inter-pose trajectory estimation. Cross-pose consensus selection identifies a consistent initialization from single-pose extrinsic proposals. Joint optimization then combines image-edge, plane, and normal constraints to refine a shared LiDAR–camera transformation and a correction to the user-measured AprilTag size.
blocks.zh: 联合多姿校正. 我们把框架扩大到多个独立捕获的静态显示观测数据,而不需要连续运动或相位轨迹估计。 跨项目协商一致选择从单项目外部提案中确定了一致的初始化。 联合优化之后结合了图像对接,平面,以及正常的制约来完善共享的LiDAR-camera转换并修正用户测量的AprilTag大小.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Target-Based Methods
blocks.zh: II-A 目标方法

blocks.en: Target-based LiDAR–camera calibration establishes explicit geometric correspondences using calibration objects with known patterns or structures. Existing approaches differ in their features, preparation requirements, and how targets are isolated from the scene.
blocks.zh: 基于目标的LiDAR-camera校正建立了使用有已知规律或结构的校正对象的显式几何对应. 现有办法在特点、准备要求以及目标如何与现场隔离方面各不相同。

blocks.en: Zhou et al. [ 4 ] combine checkerboard plane and boundary constraints to estimate extrinsics from a single pose, requiring reliable LiDAR edge extraction. Verma et al. [ 9 ] use checkerboard centers and normals, with user-specified board dimensions and spatial filtering bounds.
blocks.zh: 周来等. [4] 将检查板平面和边界限制结合起来,从单一姿势中估计出外形,需要可靠的LiDAR边缘取出. 维尔马等. [9] 使用棋盘中心和常态,并有用户指定的棋盘尺寸和空间过滤界限.

blocks.en: Beltrán et al. [ 5 ] register a circular-hole target against multilayer LiDAR data using manual spatial bounds.
blocks.zh: 贝尔特兰等. [5] 使用人工空间界限,对多层LiDAR数据进行循环孔目标登记.

blocks.en:
Dong et al. [ 10 ] address solid-state LiDAR calibration through a multi-target, multi-shot strategy: pseudoimages provide corner correspondences for coarse initialization, followed by refinement using multiple target planes. LCE-Calib [ 6 ] is also a multi-shot method, tracking a checkerboard across frames and accumulating point-to-plane constraints for initialization before refinement with plane and edge constraints.
These methods thus exploit multiple target observations in different ways: Dong et al. use several patterned targets, whereas LCE-Calib aggregates repeated observations of a tracked checkerboard.
blocks.zh:
董等编. [10] 通过多目标多镜头战略解决固态LiDAR校正:伪相提供角相干来进行粗放初始化,后使用多目标平面进行改进. LCE-Calib [6] 也是一种多镜头方法,在用平面和边缘限制来完善之前,跟踪一个横跨帧的跳板并积累点到飞机的制约来初始化.
因此,这些方法以不同的方式利用多重目标观测: 董等编. 使用数个定型目标,而LCE-Calib则汇总了对履带式检查板的反复观测.

blocks.en: ScreenCalib instead uses an ordinary display, pairing camera-observed AprilTags with the LiDAR-visible screen surface and boundary. Its multi-pose mode combines independently captured static placements through cross-pose consensus and joint refinement of the shared extrinsics and tag scale.
blocks.zh: ScreenCalib转而使用普通显示,将相机-可观察的AprilTags与LiDAR可见屏幕表面和边界对齐. 它的多pose模式通过交叉pose共识和共同完善共享的外延和标记尺度,结合了独立捕获的静态放置.

blocks.en: II-B Targetless Methods
blocks.zh: II-B 无目标方法

blocks.en: Targetless LiDAR–camera calibration avoids dedicated calibration objects by exploiting natural scene appearance, geometric features, or sensor motion. These approaches simplify target preparation, but their applicability depends on the availability of the measurements needed to constrain calibration.
blocks.zh: 无目标的LiDAR-camera校正通过利用自然场景外观,几何特征或感官运动来避免专用校正对象. 这些方法简化了目标编制,但其适用性取决于能否获得限制校正所需的测量。

blocks.en: Pandey et al. [ 11 ] maximize mutual information between LiDAR reflectivity and image intensity, requiring sufficient statistical dependence between the two measurements. Geometric approaches align natural features: Yuan et al. [ 7 ] use edges formed by intersecting surfaces, while Zhang et al. [ 12 ] use line features for online calibration. These methods require reliably associated and sufficiently distributed scene features.
blocks.zh: 潘德等编. [11] 最大程度地实现LiDAR反射率和图像强度之间的相互信息,需要两个测量数据之间有足够的统计依赖性. 几何法使自然特征一致: 袁等编. [7] 使用相交地表形成的边缘,而张等. [12] 在线校正使用线路特征. 这些方法需要可靠的关联和足够分布的场景特征.

blocks.en: CMRNext [ 13 ] predicts image-to-LiDAR correspondences and uncertainties, followed by robust perspective- n n -point (PnP) estimation, and supports unseen sensor configurations without retraining. MDPCalib [ 14 ] combines odometry-based initialization with learned correspondences and requires reliable odometry and adequate motion.
blocks.zh: CMRNext [13] 预测图像到LiDAR的对应和不确定性,然后是强视角-n-正点(PnP)的估算,并且支持不进行再培训的隐形传感器配置. MDPCalib [14] 将基于odometry的初始化与所学的函式结合,需要可靠的odometry和充分的运动.

blocks.en: iKalibr [ 8 ] performs targetless spatiotemporal calibration of heterogeneous sensors through dynamic initialization and continuous-time optimization. It requires informative motion and sufficient trajectory observations.
blocks.zh: iKalibr [8] 通过动态初始化和连续时间优化,对各种传感器进行无目标振幅校正. 它需要信息运动和足够的轨迹观测。

blocks.en: Han et al. [ 15 ] propose UniCalib, which converts camera images and sparse LiDAR points into unified dense depth maps and estimates probabilistic flow to represent cross-modal correspondence uncertainty. A reliability map and perceptually weighted sparse-flow loss suppress unreliable regions, improving robustness to occlusions and dynamic objects.
blocks.zh: 韩等. [15]提出UniCalib,将相机图像和稀疏的LiDAR点转换为统一的密集深度图并估算出概率流量来代表跨模式的函证不确定性. 可靠地图和可感知地加权的稀有流量损失抑制了不可靠的区域,提高了隔离和动态物体的稳健性。

blocks.en: Compared with targetless methods, ScreenCalib uses an ordinary programmable display to provide known, repeatable geometric constraints, reducing dependence on natural scene structure, texture, and sensor-motion excitation. Thus, ScreenCalib combines the low deployment burden of targetless methods with reliable geometric and marker constraints. It requires neither LiDAR reflectivity nor trajectory estimation. Surrounding-scene geometry helps distinguish competing single-pose hypotheses when the display outline is ambiguous.
blocks.zh: 相较于无目标方法,ScreenCalib使用普通可编程显示来提供已知,可重复的几何限制,减少对自然场景结构,纹理的依赖,并减少感官-运动激出. 因此,ScreenCalib将无目标方法的低部署负担与可靠的几何和标记限制结合起来。 它既不要求LiDAR反射,也不要求轨迹估计. 相邻-相地几何有助于在显示轮廓模棱两可时区分相竞争的单位假设.
